description: This is my MERN Stack project that is basically MERN stack Real Estate Marketplace. Firstly we setup project. 1: Installation of react with vite and tailwind css with vite. 2: installation of necessary extensions.(ES7, tailwindCSs intellisense, prettier, console ninja, auto Rename Tag) 3: Initialize git. 4: install react router dom ( npm i react-router-dom  )  5: creating pages and routes (src => creat folder pages > About.jsx, Home.jsx,Profile.jsx, SignIn.jsx, SignUp.jsx) 6: create routes using react router dom 7: Create Header Component npm i react-icons  (for use of icons)
